$comment: One view folder = one lazy bundle (dist/views/<folder>.js). The build registers every type listed here; docs/CONTRACT.md §1. split: Mermaid (the mermaid engine) is its own chunks, fetched on first use (amendment 2026-10-27, graph layout engines).

views.name: Graph
views.summary: Rows as nodes, edges from a property listing other rows' ids. Engine flow (default): React Flow laid out by dagre; group by draws subflows; pan, zoom, minimap. Engine mermaid: the same graph as a static Mermaid flowchart. A node opens its record.
